qualitative.gate_2_reason: Pure-play upstream copper mining company; speculative commodity price-taker whose revenue and earnings are dictated by global spot copper prices, with 100% of mining assets located in Chile.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Speculative commodity price-taker, REJECT). Antofagasta is a pure-play upstream copper miner operating in Chile. As an upstream commodity producer, it is a pure price-taker on global copper spot markets and exposed to Chilean mining royalty and water regulation risks.
qualitative.evidence: 100% of mining operations (Los Pelambres, Centinela, Antucoya, Zaldívar) are located in Chile. Revenue and cash flow swing violently with LME copper spot prices and treatment/refining charges. Mining royalties, political revisions to Chilean mining codes, and severe regional water constraints in the Atacama/Coquimbo regions present continuous operating and capital expenditure hurdles.
